page_title: BAR 1-2 PAL | Barcelona v Las Palmas 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+7' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.

90+6' That didn't go as planned! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Jasper Cillessen, who easily kept it out.
90+3' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+2' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Pau Victor (Barcelona) replaces Pau Cubarsi.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is replacing Mika Marmol.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
87' The game is interrupted now, Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Barcelona for a penalty. Play continues.
86' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Raphinha (Barcelona) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
83' Here is a change. Viti is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
83' Substitution. Kirian Rodriguez makes his way off the pitch and Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
83' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
82' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires the resulting free kick to the top right corner from the edge of the box, but Jasper Cillessen pulls off a superb save to deny him.

79' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero Vega blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
79' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
78' Pedri (Barcelona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
77' 19:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
74' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Substitution. Sandro Ramirez walks off the pitch and Marvin (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
73' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Fabio Silva is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Jasper Cillessen.

48' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
46' Hansi Flick has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Lamine Yamal comes on the pitch for Pablo Torre (Barcelona).
46' The whistle blows and Adrian Cordero Vega starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' OFF THE POST! Good play from Raphinha (Barcelona) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes against the crossbar!
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Raphinha (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!

44' Pedri (Barcelona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Jasper Cillessen, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
42' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
41' The free kick is taken by Pablo Torre (Barcelona), but ball is cleared.

32' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
32' Gavi (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
32' It's a nice effort by Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Inaki Pena. Easy save.
29' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) gets on the end of the resulting free kick, but he produces a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post!

27' Raphinha (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

26' Problems for Hansi Flick as Alejandro Balde is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Gerard Martin (Barcelona) replaces him.
22' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
22' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
20' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
19' 67:33 – the ratio of ball possession.

17' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
16' Viti (Las Palmas) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
16' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
